## About
The Library is a wood-paneled taproom in Austin with billiards, cozy booths lined with faux books, and full service bars on each level. We pour beer on tap, frozen drinks and cocktails, so there's something for every taste.
Come by for happy hour, or bring your group and settle into a VIP booth with bottle service. We host birthdays, graduations, and bachelor and bachelorette parties, and there's a photo booth to help you remember the night.

## Services
- Wells, domestics and drafts: Wells, domestics and drafts at $3.50. ($3.50)
- House margaritas: House margaritas at $4.50. ($4.50)
- Beers on tap, frozen drinks and cocktails: 22 beers on tap, plus frozen drinks and cocktails.
- VIP booths and bottle service: Bring the night to your table with one of our 3 VIP booths and a wide selection of bottle service.
- Reserve a booth or a whole level for your party: Reserve a VIP booth or a whole level for your group.

## FAQ
Q: Do you have VIP booths?
A: Yes. We have 3 VIP booths with a wide selection of bottle service.

Q: What kinds of parties can I book?
A: Birthdays, graduations, bachelor and bachelorette parties and more. Get in touch and we'll help you plan it.

## What customers say
- "6th Street is the place to be for a fun and great time in Austin. Out of all the bars and clubs I checked out during my stay in Austin "The Library Bar" was the best. The staff are excellent, the layout in the bar is tremendous, and if you want to meet some amazing people this is the place to be. Can't wait to come back again." (Eric Myers, 5/5)
- "I visited this bar in the afternoon and then later at night. Seemed to be very different places
During the day they offer lots of sports on the big TVs above the bar. They also have beer pong and plenty of space to mingle.
At night, the place just goes crazy and smells very strongly of tequila" (Peter L, 5/5)
